candidate.answerReason: Sharing one whole equally among four portions gives one quarter in each portion.

methods.label: Share one whole equally
methods.explanation: Divide 1 into 4 equal parts. Each part is \(\frac{1}{4}\).
methods.levelReason: Equal sharing and unit fractions are elementary concepts taught before grade 5; no reciprocal rule is needed.
